messages:
Priya Rao: FYI — just pulled the AWS Marketplace invoice for Feb and there are duplicate charges on the reseller line item for Acme Corp. Need to reconcile before close. Anyone able to jump in?
Liam Chen: Can you paste the invoice ID and the SKU/line item? I can open a ticket with AWS if it's on their side.
Priya Rao: Invoice ID `INV-AWS-2026-02-ACM-9987`
Priya Rao: Line items: `marketplace-resale` x2, charges identical, net total doubled. I exported the csv, dropping snippet here:
```
line_item_id,sku,description,amount
12345,MW-RESELLER,Acme yearly seat,12500
12346,MW-RESELLER,Acme yearly seat,12500
```
Jorge Alvarez: Do we have a reseller pass-through arrangement for Acme or did Sales route via their marketplace reseller? Might affect whether AWS credits/fees apply.
Ellen Park: Acme is on our channel partner resale (PartnerX) — they signed via partner portal in Jan. PartnerX should have the listing. We invoiced them directly for usage outside marketplace.
Liam Chen: Ok that makes sense. Two hypotheses: 1) AWS billed both PartnerX and us due to a listing config error, or 2) PartnerX submitted a duplicate usage report. I'll open AWS support now — need the full CSV and the consolidated bill.
Priya Rao: Uploading consolidated bill to /finance/shared/marketplace/INV-AWS-2026-02-ACM-9987.pdf and CSV to the same folder.
billing-bot: Auto-check: invoice duplicate pattern detected (2 identical rows). Suggested tag: `marketplace-duplicate`.
Liam Chen: Thanks. @AWS Marketplace Support (cc), please advise whether an invoice correction/credit is standard in this scenario and ETA if confirmed.
AWS Marketplace Support: Thanks for the report — can you provide the partner registration ID for PartnerX and the partner-signed agreement ID? We'll triage with billing ops.
Ellen Park: PartnerX registration ID `PX-4472`. Agreement ID `PX-ACM-2025-03`
Jorge Alvarez: From accounting POV we should not recognize the duplicate charge until AWS issues a credit or partner sends reversal. I'll tentatively block recognition in ledger and flag cashflow delta.
Priya Rao: Agreed. Can someone add a note to the Acme customer record to prevent duplicate invoicing?
Liam Chen: Adding note now. Also filing AWS support case #AWS-2026-13728. I'll paste updates here when they respond.
Priya Rao: Thanks. If AWS queues are slow, we may need to issue a provisional refund to PartnerX depending on their reconciliation policy — @Ellen can you confirm PartnerX's refund SLA?
Ellen Park: PartnerX usually issues partner-level credits within 5 business days once we confirm. I'll ping my contact.
billing-bot: Reminder: month-end close in 7 days.
Priya Rao: Noted. Will follow up hourly until this is resolved. :eyes:
